subject: Tighten forecasts and boost rep productivity
body:
I noticed Salesforce's recent FY26 Q2 results and wanted to share some timely observations. With subscription growth and predictable renewals, aligning coverage and forecast models is likely top of mind.

- Q2 results show subscription & support revenue up ~11% Y/Y and performance above guidance.
- Zero Copy Partner Network enables secure, bidirectional zero-copy integrations to reduce reconciliation and surface fresher opportunity signals.
- Agentforce conversational agents can automate CRM tasks (data entry, meeting summaries, lead triage) to increase rep productivity and throughput.

If helpful, I can send a one-page pilot outline to test zero-copy syncs and Agentforce for a top pod, continue this via email, or schedule a brief call.
